# XCTest completed-failure fixture

These reduced JSON fixtures derive from the retained local task 020 native attempt 1
(11 cases: 7 passed, 4 failed), exported with Xcode xcresulttool. The invocation retains
only action status/timestamps, metrics and issue records; machine/user identifiers,
log references and unrelated metadata were removed. Source locations use `/fixture/`.
The modern summary and test tree retain only classifier inputs. `Uncategorized` is the
actual issue type, not an invented assertion category.

These fixtures validate evidence classification, not current native app acceptance.
Historical raw results are not rewritten. Test mutations exercise infrastructure errors,
incomplete evidence, ambiguous identity, teardown attribution and mismatched aggregates.
